entries: Added `/model <name> <prompt>`, which runs a single prompt on another model and then returns the session to the model it was using, so you can consult a different model mid-conversation without disturbing your saved default.
Added a `conversation_title` field to the JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts, so they can show the active conversation's name and pick up renames immediately.

Added an `agents` list to custom agent Markdown frontmatter, letting an agent declare the subagents it depends on using the same workspace-relative, absolute, and agent-relative path rules as `skills`.
Improved `/model` to show a `[model]` argument hint as you type, so the command's arguments are discoverable without opening help.

Improved the `/settings` panel so each Verbosity option explains itself as you highlight it, describing whether tool calls, commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table.

Improved the sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens to use the CLI's standard styled key hints, which follow your color scheme and keybindings and drop the navigation hint when only one option is available.
Changed `/model <name>` to report `Model already set to <name>` when the session is already using that model, instead of reporting a switch that did not happen.
Fixed tool calls to MCP servers accepting arguments the server's own schema never declared, so an invented parameter is now rejected and corrected instead of being silently dropped.

Fixed headless runs with `-p` silently skipping tool actions they were not permitted to take, which now end with a notice naming the refused actions and report them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output.

Fixed `?` in Vim Normal mode opening the shortcuts panel while the prompt already contained text, so character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?` work; `?` still opens shortcuts on an empty prompt.
Fixed `/model` with no argument doing nothing when run before the session had finished starting up, so it now opens the model picker.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) exiting before the session finished shutting down, which could drop the run's trailing conversation history before it reached disk.
Fixed a redundant approval prompt when the agent reads or writes another conversation's artifact files after you have already allowed access to files outside your workspace.

title.zh-TW: `/model` 支援單次提問切換，輸入提示與啟動選單全面修正
title.en: `/model` Supports Single-Prompt Model Switching with Comprehensive Fixes to Input Hints and Startup Menus

body.zh-TW: 對話進行到一半想換個模型問一句話，現在不必更改整體設定。⟦像向主治醫師看診時，中途請隔壁專科專家進診間單獨看一張片子，問完立即回到主治醫師，不必重新辦理轉院手續。⟧新指令 `/model <name> <prompt>` 讓你用另一個模型跑單次提問，結束後工作階段（你與 AI 進行對話的一段連線）自動切回原本模型，完全不影響已儲存的預設值。寫完程式想打 `/model gemini-3.8-flash 檢查資安漏洞` 諮詢其他觀點，這正是使用時機。此外，輸入 `/model` 時會即時浮現 `[model]` 參數提示，不開求助說明也能知道用法。若工作階段已在該模型，指令改為回報 `Model already set to <name>` 而非誤報切換。在工作階段啟動完成前輸入不帶參數的 `/model`，現在也會正常開啟模型挑選器。
body.en: You no longer need to change your global settings when you want to switch models for a single question mid-conversation. ⟦It is like consulting your primary physician and having a specialist step into the examination room just to review a single scan, immediately returning to your primary physician once done without undergoing hospital transfer procedures.⟧ The new `/model <name> <prompt>` command lets you run a single prompt on another model, automatically returning the session to its original model afterward without affecting your saved defaults. If you finish writing code and want to run `/model gemini-3.8-flash check for security vulnerabilities` to consult another perspective, this is the exact use case. In addition, typing `/model` now displays a real-time `[model]` argument hint so you know how to use it without opening help. If the session is already using that model, the command now reports `Model already set to <name>` instead of falsely reporting a switch. Running `/model` without arguments before the session finishes starting up also now properly opens the model picker.

items.original:
Added `/model <name> <prompt>`, which runs a single prompt on another model and then returns the session to the model it was using, so you can consult a different model mid-conversation without disturbing your saved default.
Improved `/model` to show a `[model]` argument hint as you type, so the command's arguments are discoverable without opening help.
Changed `/model <name>` to report `Model already set to <name>` when the session is already using that model, instead of reporting a switch that did not happen.
Fixed `/model` with no argument doing nothing when run before the session had finished starting up, so it now opens the model picker.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 自訂代理支援 `agents` 清單，直接宣告相依子代理路徑
title.en: Custom Markdown Agents Support `agents` List to Directly Declare Dependent Subagent Paths

body.zh-TW:
替專案設計多代理協作時，自訂代理現在能直接宣告自己專屬的下層幫手。在定義代理的 Markdown 檔案開頭，檔案標頭（frontmatter，用三條橫線包夾的設定區塊）新增了 `agents` 清單。你可以直接列出該代理依賴的各個子代理，並完全比照 `skills` 技能的定位方式，自由使用工作區相對路徑、絕對路徑或代理相對路徑：

```
---
agents:
  - ./researcher.md       # 代理相對路徑
  - subagents/verifier.md # 工作區相對路徑
  - /global/audit.md      # 絕對路徑
---
```

當你撰寫一份資安稽核代理，希望它自動叫出專門查閱程式碼的輔助幫手，只要在定義檔開頭寫好這份清單，系統就會精準載入依賴項目。⟦好比主廚在宴席菜單頂端註明各道菜餚專屬的備料助手與冷盤學徒，後廚依名冊在開工前配齊人手，不必等客人入座後才手忙腳亂到處調派支援。⟧
body.en:
When designing multi-agent collaboration for a project, custom agents can now directly declare their own subordinate helpers. The Markdown frontmatter at the beginning of an agent definition file has added an `agents` list. You can directly list the subagents this agent depends on, using workspace-relative paths, absolute paths, or agent-relative paths just like `skills`:

```
---
agents:
  - ./researcher.md       # Agent-relative path
  - subagents/verifier.md # Workspace-relative path
  - /global/audit.md      # Absolute path
---
```

When creating a security audit agent that needs to automatically invoke a dedicated code inspection helper, simply declaring this list at the top of the definition file ensures the system accurately loads the dependencies. ⟦Like a head chef listing dedicated prep assistants and cold-dish apprentices at the top of a banquet menu so the kitchen can staff up before work begins, rather than scrambling to dispatch helpers after guests are seated.⟧

items.original: Added an `agents` list to custom agent Markdown frontmatter, letting an agent declare the subagents it depends on using the same workspace-relative, absolute, and agent-relative path rules as `skills`.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列與視窗標題腳本新增 `conversation_title`，即時同步對話重新命名
title.en: Status Line and Window Title Scripts Add `conversation_title` to Synchronize Renamed Conversations in Real Time

body.zh-TW:
想要在螢幕邊界隨時掌握當前對話，自訂腳本現在能取得更豐富的資訊。⟦如同會議室門口掛著的數位名牌，只要發起人更改專案名稱，螢幕隨即同步換上新標題，讓走進門的人一目了然。⟧傳遞給自訂狀態列（終端機最底下的即時資訊列）與視窗標題腳本的 JSON 酬載中，新增了 `conversation_title` 欄位。你的腳本可以直接讀取該欄位來顯示當前進行中的對話名稱，即使中途為對話重新命名，介面也能立即跟進最新標題，不再停留在舊名稱或預設代號：

```
{
  "conversation_title": "重構登入模組"
}
```

當你同時開啟多個終端機視窗處理不同專案，只要腳本讀取這個新欄位，就能清楚辨認每個視窗正在進行的任務主題。
body.en:
Custom scripts can now retrieve richer information to help you track active conversations at the screen edge at any time. ⟦Like a digital nameplate outside a conference room that instantly updates when the organizer renames the project, giving anyone walking in immediate clarity.⟧ The JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts now includes a `conversation_title` field. Your scripts can directly read this field to display the active conversation's name, picking up renames immediately rather than staying stuck on old names or default identifiers:

```
{
  "conversation_title": "Refactor login module"
}
```

When running multiple terminal windows across different projects, having your script read this new field makes it easy to identify the task topic in each window.

items.original: Added a `conversation_title` field to the JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts, so they can show the active conversation's name and pick up renames immediately.

title.zh-TW: 無頭與列印模式 `-p` 執行加固，未授權動作明確列出且紀錄完整落盤
title.en: Hardened Execution for Headless and Print Mode `-p`: Unauthorized Actions Explicitly Listed and Records Flushed to Disk

body.zh-TW: 把 AI 放入自動化排程背景執行，最怕工具被拒絕時毫無動靜、或者紀錄沒寫完就中途斷線。⟦宛如派出全自動無人採樣車，遇到未經授權的管制區域時不再裝作沒事直接略過，而是在日誌中白紙黑字寫明被拒絕的地點，且返航時一定等所有檢測數據完整寫入隨身碟才關閉電源。⟧以 `-p` 參數跑 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）時，過去系統若遇到未獲授權的工具動作，會默默跳過不執行；現在程式結束時會明確列出被拒絕的動作名稱，並在 JSON 輸出中標記為 `denied_actions`。此外，列印模式以前在工作階段尚未完成關閉前就過早退出，容易導致末尾的對話歷史紀錄還沒寫入磁碟就被丟棄；現在會確實等待工作階段完整落盤後才退出。
body.en: When running AI in background automated schedules, the worst issues are silent tool rejections or dropped records due to premature disconnections. ⟦Like an autonomous sampling rover that, when encountering an unauthorized restricted zone, no longer skips past it silently but clearly logs the refused location in writing, and always waits for all telemetry to flush to storage before powering off on its return.⟧ When running headless with `-p`, the system previously skipped unauthorized tool actions silently; it now ends with a notice naming the refused actions and reports them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output. In addition, print mode previously exited before the session finished shutting down, which could drop trailing conversation history before it reached disk; it now properly waits for the session to finish writing to disk before exiting.

items.original:
Fixed headless runs with `-p` silently skipping tool actions they were not permitted to take, which now end with a notice naming the refused actions and report them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) exiting before the session finished shutting down, which could drop the run's trailing conversation history before it reached disk.

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫嚴格核對規格，虛構參數主動拒絕並修正
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Strictly Validate Schemas, Actively Rejecting and Correcting Invented Parameters

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 連接外部伺服器執行專屬工具，傳入參數的檢驗標準現在變得更加嚴密。過去呼叫 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，如果 AI 自行虛構了該伺服器規格架構中從未宣告過的額外參數，舊版系統往往會默默丟棄這些多餘參數而不提示，導致呼叫行為偏離預期。現在底層驗證機制已修正，遇到規格外的虛構參數會主動予以拒絕並要求修正，確保每次工具呼叫都嚴格符合定義。⟦這就像去銀行臨櫃填寫匯款單，如果填表人自作主張在空白處多勾選了規格從未印製的自創項目，櫃員不會裝作沒看見直接劃掉，而是會當場退單並指引你填寫合規欄位。⟧
body.en: Validation standards for passing arguments have become much stricter when connecting AI to external servers for dedicated tools. When calling MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in the past, if the AI invented extra arguments never declared in the server's schema, the system often silently dropped them without notice, causing unexpected behavior. The underlying validation mechanism is now fixed to actively reject and correct invented parameters outside the schema, ensuring every tool call strictly matches definitions. ⟦Like filling out a bank transfer slip where, if the applicant checks custom options never printed on the form, the teller will not silently cross them out, but will reject the slip on the spot and guide you to fill out valid fields.⟧

items.original: Fixed tool calls to MCP servers accepting arguments the server's own schema never declared, so an invented parameter is now rejected and corrected instead of being silently dropped.

title.zh-TW: 設定面板詳述輸出詳細度，初始引導畫面按鍵提示全面標準化
title.en: Settings Panel Details Verbosity Levels, and Onboarding Key Hints Are Fully Standardized

body.zh-TW: 在終端機調整設定或初次登入時，畫面引導變得更加貼合你的使用習慣。⟦在科技展廳的觸控機台前瀏覽時，每當手勢移到不同選項，旁邊的動態看板就會詳細解釋功能差異，且按鈕背光會自動配合展廳色調，遇到單一通道時更會主動收起多餘的方向提示。⟧開啟 `/settings` 設定面板時，游標移到各個 Verbosity 詳細度選項上，畫面會即時展開說明文字。它會詳細描述工具呼叫、終端指令與思考推導是完整展開顯示，還是濃縮進 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計量表中。此外，帳號登入與 Google Cloud 設定引導畫面全面改用命令列標準樣式的按鍵提示，能完全跟隨你的終端配色與自訂鍵位綁定，當畫面上只有單一選項可選時，系統也會主動隱藏多餘的方向導覽提示。
body.en: On-screen guidance fits your habits much better when tweaking settings in the terminal or logging in for the first time. ⟦Like browsing a touchscreen kiosk in a tech showroom where highlighting different options prompts a dynamic billboard to explain functional differences, button backlights adapt to showroom colors, and navigation arrows hide when only a single path exists.⟧ When opening the `/settings` panel, highlighting each Verbosity option now expands explanatory text in real time. It describes in detail whether tool calls, terminal commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table. In addition, sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens now use standard styled CLI key hints that follow your terminal color scheme and custom keybindings, dropping navigation hints when only one option is available.

items.original:
Improved the `/settings` panel so each Verbosity option explains itself as you highlight it, describing whether tool calls, commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table.
Improved the sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens to use the CLI's standard styled key hints, which follow your color scheme and keybindings and drop the navigation hint when only one option is available.

title.zh-TW: Vim 常規模式解開 `?` 按鍵衝突，行內搜尋與替換指令順暢運作
title.en: Vim Normal Mode Resolves `?` Key Conflict, Restoring Inline Search and Replace Operators

body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機開啟 Vim 鍵位的工程師，現在於輸入列進行行內定位時不再誤觸彈出視窗。過去在 Vim Normal mode（Vim 編輯器的常規命令模式）下，只要輸入框內已經包含文字，按下 `?` 鍵就會錯誤地觸發快速鍵面板跳出，導致 `f?`、`t?` 以及 `df?` 等字元搜尋與替換操作符全面失靈。現在這項按鍵攔截問題已經修復，當輸入列已有文字時，這些搜尋與替換指令都能順暢運作；只有在輸入列完全空白的待機狀態下，按下 `?` 才會如常開啟快速鍵說明。⟦彷彿在打字機上編修文件，當滾筒夾著稿紙且正在編輯時，按下特殊標點會精確執行行內字元搜尋、跳位與替換，只有在完全抽空稿紙的待機狀態下，同一個按鍵才會化身為叫出操作手冊的呼叫鈴。⟧
body.en: Engineers used to Vim keybindings in the terminal will no longer accidentally trigger popup panels during inline navigation in the prompt. Previously in Vim Normal mode, pressing `?` while the prompt already contained text incorrectly opened the shortcuts panel, breaking character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?`. This key intercept issue is now fixed so that search and replace commands work smoothly when the prompt has text; pressing `?` only opens shortcut help when the prompt is completely empty. ⟦Like editing on a typewriter where pressing a punctuation key performs precise inline character search, jumping, and replacement while paper is loaded, and only acts as a service bell summoning the manual when the roller is completely empty.⟧

items.original: Fixed `?` in Vim Normal mode opening the shortcuts panel while the prompt already contained text, so character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?` work; `?` still opens shortcuts on an empty prompt.

title.zh-TW: 已授權存取工作區外檔案時，讀寫跨對話產物不再跳多餘確認
title.en: Reading and Writing Cross-Conversation Artifacts No Longer Prompts for Redundant Approval When Workspace Access Is Granted

body.zh-TW: 跨對話調閱過往產出的分析文件，不必再被重複彈出的確認視窗打斷工作節奏。當使用者在對話中已經明確核准代理存取工作區以外的檔案路徑，後續若代理需要讀取或寫入另一段對話所產生的產物（artifact，獨立生成的各類文件或程式碼）檔案，過去系統仍會反覆彈出多餘的授權詢問對話框，中斷連續操作；現在這項重複提示已被徹底修復，只要先前已放行外部路徑，代理就能順暢讀寫其他對話的產物。⟦入住全包式度假村，手腕上已經配戴通行全區的識別手環，走進隔壁活動中心借閱其他房客留下的共享桌遊，櫃檯就不該要求你再次出示護照並重複簽名。⟧
body.en: Retrieving past analysis documents across conversations no longer interrupts your workflow with repeated confirmation popups. Once you explicitly allow an agent access to file paths outside your workspace, the system previously still prompted repeatedly for approval whenever the agent read or wrote artifact files created by another conversation; this redundant prompt is now fixed so the agent smoothly accesses artifacts from other conversations once external paths have been permitted. ⟦Like staying at an all-inclusive resort where wearing an all-access wristband means the front desk should not ask for your passport and signature again when you borrow board games from the recreation center next door.⟧

items.original: Fixed a redundant approval prompt when the agent reads or writes another conversation's artifact files after you have already allowed access to files outside your workspace.

entries: Added half-page scrolling with `Ctrl+D` and `Ctrl+U` to the artifact viewer.
Added the `pickerGrouping` setting to `/config` and `settings.json` to configure the default conversation list view in `/resume` (flat or grouped by workspace).
Improved terminal ASCII diagram rendering for Mermaid flowcharts in the artifact viewer and conversation.
Improved `/logout` execution time by short-circuiting token removal directly to file storage when keyring storage is bypassed or unreachable.
Changed unselected model families in the interactive `/model` picker to default to medium reasoning effort instead of low.
Fixed subagent tasks unexpectedly prompting for tool approval in always-proceed mode while viewing the subagent details panel.
Fixed orphaned Git worktrees accumulating on disk under `.system_generated/worktrees` when killing subagents or deleting conversations.
Fixed SQLite database WAL checkpointing on CLI exit so trailing session metadata updates are flushed to disk before shutdown.
Fixed customization discovery logging spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace.

title.zh-TW: 產物檢視器支援快速翻半頁，Mermaid 流程圖終端圖表更清晰
title.en: Artifact viewer adds half-page scrolling, clearer terminal Mermaid flowcharts

body.zh-TW: 閱讀 AI 產出的長篇架構文件或分析報告時，畫面瀏覽與圖表呈現變得更加流暢。⟦猶如在終端機裡翻閱長篇樂譜，以前只能一行行微調捲動，現在輕按按鍵就能一次翻過半面樂譜，頁面上的流程箭頭與架構符號也排版得井然有序。⟧在產物檢視器（artifact viewer，檢視 AI 產生之獨立檔案的瀏覽視窗）中，現在支援按下 `Ctrl+D` 向下翻動半頁與 `Ctrl+U` 向上翻動半頁。同時，在對話紀錄與產物檢視器裡繪製 Mermaid 流程圖時，系統改進了終端機 ASCII 純文字圖表的渲染排版，讓方塊節點與連線更整齊易讀。
body.en: Reading long architecture documents or analysis reports generated by AI is now smoother with clearer diagrams. ⟦Like flipping through a long sheet music score in a terminal where you previously had to scroll line by line, you can now turn half a page with a single keypress, while process arrows and structural symbols stay neatly aligned.⟧ The artifact viewer (a browsing window for inspecting standalone files generated by AI) now supports pressing `Ctrl+D` to scroll down half a page and `Ctrl+U` to scroll up half a page. Meanwhile, when rendering Mermaid flowcharts in conversation history and the artifact viewer, the system improves terminal ASCII plain-text diagram layouts, making box nodes and connecting lines cleaner and easier to read.

items.original:
Added half-page scrolling with `Ctrl+D` and `Ctrl+U` to the artifact viewer.
Improved terminal ASCII diagram rendering for Mermaid flowcharts in the artifact viewer and conversation.

title.zh-TW: `/resume` 新增 `pickerGrouping` 設定，自由指定歷史對話預設檢視
title.en: `/resume` adds `pickerGrouping` setting to customize default conversation list view

body.zh-TW:
每次使用 `/resume` 挑選歷史對話時，現在可以依照個人偏好鎖定預設的呈現清單。⟦就像在氣象 App 裡把預設城市鎖定成台北——每次開啟就直接顯示台北的天氣頁面，不必重選；要切換成依地區分組或平鋪全部城市，只要調一次設定，日後開啟自動套用。⟧系統在 `/config` 指令與 `settings.json` 設定檔中新增了 `pickerGrouping` 設定項目。你可以將其設定為依工作區分組或是平鋪清單（flat），讓對話挑選介面一開啟就呈現你習慣的版面結構：

```
{
  "pickerGrouping": "workspace"
}
```

可在設定檔中指定為 workspace 或 flat。
body.en:
When using `/resume` to pick past conversations, you can now lock in a default list view based on personal preference. ⟦Like setting your weather app's default city to Taipei so opening the app immediately shows Taipei's weather without having to reselect, switching to grouping by region or showing all cities flat requires just one setting tweak and applies automatically thereafter.⟧ The system adds the `pickerGrouping` setting to the `/config` command and `settings.json` configuration file. You can configure it to group by workspace or display a flat list, ensuring the conversation picker opens in your preferred layout:

```
{
  "pickerGrouping": "workspace"
}
```

It can be set to workspace or flat in the configuration file.

items.original: Added the `pickerGrouping` setting to `/config` and `settings.json` to configure the default conversation list view in `/resume` (flat or grouped by workspace).

title.zh-TW: `/model` 選單未指定模型預設思考力度，由低檔提升為中檔
title.en: Unselected model families in `/model` picker now default to medium reasoning effort instead of low

body.zh-TW: 在終端機使用 `/model` 挑選模型時，未特別手動指定思考深度的模型家族現在會主動投入更多推理思考。過去在互動式選單中切換模型時，未經額外設定的模型預設會採用 low（低推理努力程度）。現在預設檔位全面調整為 medium（中等推理努力程度），讓模型在處理程式碼或分析架構時進行更周全的推導。⟦就像把電風扇的預設風速從低速換成中速——插上電一啟動就直接在中速運轉，不必每次手動往上撥到慣用的檔位。⟧
body.en: When selecting models via `/model` in the terminal, model families without an explicitly specified thinking depth now proactively invest more reasoning effort. Previously, when switching models in the interactive picker, models without extra configuration defaulted to low reasoning effort. The default level has now been updated to medium reasoning effort, enabling models to perform more thorough reasoning when writing code or analyzing architecture. ⟦Like changing an electric fan's default speed from low to medium—powering it on immediately runs at medium speed without needing to manually toggle up to your preferred setting every time.⟧

items.original: Changed unselected model families in the interactive `/model` picker to default to medium reasoning effort instead of low.

title.zh-TW: 子代理全自動執行不再誤停，開啟詳細面板不跳授權詢問
title.en: Subagents stay fully automated without stopping when opening details panel in always-proceed mode

body.zh-TW: 放手讓子代理獨立執行任務時，查看即時進度不再意外打斷自動化流程。在啟用 always-proceed（一律放行，不逐一詢問工具授權的自動執行模式）的狀態下，過去使用者只要切換開啟子代理詳細資訊面板，原本在背景順暢運作的子代理任務會突然跳出工具執行確認視窗，中斷原本的連續作業。這項問題已經修復，現在開啟或瀏覽詳細面板時，子代理會維持全自動推進。⟦這好比在全自動洗車機旁透過透明觀景窗查看清洗進度，機械手臂不會因為有人在窗外觀看就突然煞車要求手動確認。⟧
body.en: Checking live progress while letting subagents work autonomously no longer unexpectedly interrupts automated workflows. When running in always-proceed mode (an automatic execution mode that approves tool usage without prompting for each one), opening the subagent details panel previously caused subagent tasks running smoothly in the background to suddenly pop up tool approval prompts, halting continuous operations. This issue has now been resolved, so subagents continue running fully automatically when opening or viewing the details panel. ⟦Like watching a car wash's progress through a transparent observation window, where the robotic arms do not suddenly brake and demand manual confirmation just because someone is looking through the glass.⟧

items.original: Fixed subagent tasks unexpectedly prompting for tool approval in always-proceed mode while viewing the subagent details panel.

title.zh-TW: 終止子代理與刪除對話自動清除孤立工作樹，釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Terminating subagents and deleting conversations now cleans up orphaned Git worktrees to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 結束多代理協作或清理舊對話時，硬碟不再默默累積暫存資料夾。⟦如同工坊在學徒收工或專案結案時，自動將臨時搭建的平行副工作台拆卸清理，不再讓廢棄支架堆滿倉庫角落。⟧系統在呼叫子代理進行平行作業時，會於 `.system_generated/worktrees` 目錄下建立 worktree（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。過去在強制終止子代理或刪除歷史對話時，這些臨時工作樹常未被完全移除而變成孤立殘留檔案。現在清理機制已修正，會在結束時確實移除並釋放磁碟空間。
body.en: Ending multi-agent collaboration or cleaning up old conversations no longer silently accumulates temporary folders on disk. ⟦Like a workshop automatically dismantling and clearing out temporary parallel workstations when apprentices pack up or projects wrap up, preventing discarded frames from piling up in warehouse corners.⟧ When calling subagents for parallel execution, the system creates worktrees (a Git feature that creates multiple parallel copies of the same project) under the `.system_generated/worktrees` directory. Previously, when forcefully terminating subagents or deleting conversation history, these temporary worktrees were often not fully removed, leaving behind orphaned lingering files. The cleanup mechanism is now fixed to reliably remove them upon completion and reclaim disk space.

items.original: Fixed orphaned Git worktrees accumulating on disk under `.system_generated/worktrees` when killing subagents or deleting conversations.

title.zh-TW: 改善登出速度並落盤中繼資料，排除暫存目錄虛假日誌
title.en: Faster `/logout`, metadata flushed to disk on exit, and spurious logs eliminated for temporary directories

body.zh-TW: 在登出帳號、結束指令與載入自訂設定時，底層的狀態處理與儲存機制進行了一批強化。使用 `/logout` 登出時，若系統金鑰圈被繞過或無法連線，系統會直接捷徑刪除檔案中的 token（授權令牌），縮短登出耗費的時間。在離開命令列介面時，系統修復了 SQLite 資料庫的預寫日誌檢查點機制，確保關閉前將最後的工作階段中繼資料完整寫入硬碟。此外，自訂功能探索機制在存取暫存目錄或工作區以外的路徑時，也不會再印出多餘的虛假錯誤日誌。⟦猶如劇院散場後的後台收尾：工作人員先把道具登記入庫，再確認燈控系統完整歸零存檔，最後閘門落鎖，不再對後台外的公共走廊誤觸警報。⟧
body.en: Underlying state handling and persistence mechanisms have received a batch of enhancements during account logout, command exits, and customization loading. When logging out via `/logout`, if the system keyring is bypassed or unreachable, the system now short-circuits token removal directly to file storage, speeding up logout execution. When exiting the command-line interface, the system fixes SQLite database WAL checkpointing to ensure trailing session metadata is fully flushed to disk before shutdown. Furthermore, customization discovery no longer logs spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace. ⟦Like backstage wrap-up after a theater show ends: staff first register props into storage, verify the lighting control system is fully reset and saved, and finally lock the gates without accidentally triggering alarms for public corridors outside the backstage area.⟧

items.original:
Improved `/logout` execution time by short-circuiting token removal directly to file storage when keyring storage is bypassed or unreachable.
Fixed SQLite database WAL checkpointing on CLI exit so trailing session metadata updates are flushed to disk before shutdown.
Fixed customization discovery logging spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace.

title.en: `/resume` Adds Directory Grouping View for Toggling Conversation History

body.zh-TW: 你在多個專案資料夾之間切換工作時，要在歷史對話裡找回之前的討論，現在多了更清楚的分類方式。⟦像把抽屜裡混成一疊的文件，按專案資料夾分類收納，只要按一下快速鍵，就能在平鋪清單與活頁夾分組之間自由切換。⟧使用 `/resume` 指令挑選過去的對話時，新增了自由啟用的工作區分組檢視。只要按下 `Ctrl+F` 快速鍵，就能在原本平鋪的對話清單與依目錄分組的檢視之間即時切換，迅速找到特定專案底下的歷史紀錄。
body.en: When switching between multiple project directories, finding past discussions in your conversation history is now much more organized. ⟦It is like sorting a messy pile of documents from a drawer into project folders, letting you switch between a flat list and categorized binders with a single keystroke.⟧ When using the `/resume` command to pick a past conversation, you can now opt into a workspace-grouped view. Simply press `Ctrl+F` to toggle between the flat conversation list and conversations grouped by directory, quickly locating history for a specific project.

items.original: Added an opt-in workspace-grouped view to the `/resume` conversation picker, allowing users to toggle between a flat list and conversations grouped by directory with `Ctrl+F`.

title.zh-TW: 模型目錄收錄 Gemini 3.8 Flash，API 金鑰連線多一項輕快選擇
title.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash Added to Model Catalog for API Key Connections

body.zh-TW: 偏好直接使用官方 API 金鑰連線的開發者，模型清單中迎來了更新的生力軍。⟦這就像在工具箱裡添置了一把高轉速的輕便電動起子，只要插上專用電池，就能隨時拿出來處理講求反應速度與俐落節奏的組裝工作。⟧只要你在環境中設定 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線，模型目錄中就會列出最新的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 模型。在進行日常程式碼查詢或快速編輯時，便能直接在選單中指定此模型，享有更充裕的模型調配彈性。
body.en: Developers who prefer connecting directly with an official API key now have a fresh, responsive option in their model list. ⟦It is like adding a high-speed, lightweight electric screwdriver to your toolbox, ready to tackle assembly tasks requiring fast reactions whenever you plug in its battery.⟧ Once you configure `GEMINI_API_KEY` in your environment, the latest Gemini 3.8 Flash model appears in the model catalog. When performing routine code lookups or quick edits, you can select this model directly from the menu to enjoy greater flexibility.

items.original: Added Gemini 3.8 Flash to the model catalog when connecting with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 自訂代理預設繼承全域資源，開箱即用周遭技能與規則
title.en: Markdown Custom Agents Inherit Ambient Skills, Rules, and Subagents by Default

body.zh-TW: 用 Markdown 檔案撰寫自訂代理時，現在能享有與預設代理完全一致的資源配置。過去自訂代理不會自動承接環境裡現有的各項技能、規則與子代理（subagents，分擔特定任務的輔助代理），讓自訂助理往往少了一整套基本能力；現在自訂代理一律預設繼承周遭的所有技能、規則與子代理，開箱就能直接調用環境資源。⟦這好比新到職的特助走進辦公室，桌上已自動配齊團隊現成的工具箱、作業規範與協力助手名冊，不必凡事從頭自行申請。⟧
body.en: When defining custom agents with Markdown files, they now receive the exact same resource configuration as default agents. Previously, custom agents did not automatically inherit ambient skills, rules, and subagents (specialized auxiliary agents that handle specific tasks), often leaving them without essential capabilities. Now, custom agents inherit all surrounding skills, rules, and subagents by default, ready to use ambient resources out of the box. ⟦It is like a newly hired assistant walking into an office to find the team's standard toolkit, operating guidelines, and directory of helpers already neatly set up on their desk without having to request each one from scratch.⟧

items.original: Changed custom agents defined in Markdown to inherit ambient skills, rules, and subagents by default, matching the configuration of default agents.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Markdown 自訂代理相對路徑解析，以定義檔所在目錄為基準
title.en: Fixed Relative Path Resolution in Markdown Custom Agents Based on Definition Directory

body.zh-TW: 你在自訂代理的 Markdown 定義檔中引用周邊模組時，相對路徑不再因為執行位置不同而迷路。過去在代理定義檔中若使用相對路徑來指定子代理與外掛程式，系統常以當前執行目錄而非定義檔所在位置進行解析，導致檔案找不到；現在相對路徑一律以該代理定義檔所在的資料夾為基準正確解析。⟦這宛如依據建築平面圖找房間，說明書上的「走廊左側第三間」一律以這棟大樓的入口為基準計算，不會因為你站在不同大門外就指錯方位。⟧
body.en: When referencing nearby modules in a custom agent's Markdown definition file, relative paths will no longer get lost depending on where you run the tool. Previously, when specifying subagents and plugins using relative paths in an agent definition, paths were often resolved against the current working directory instead of the definition file's location, causing files to go missing. Relative paths now resolve correctly against the directory containing that agent definition file. ⟦It is like navigating a building floor plan where instructions like "third door on the left" are always measured from that building's main entrance, rather than pointing in the wrong direction because you happen to be standing outside another gate.⟧

items.original: Fixed relative path resolution in Markdown-defined custom agents so relative subagent and plugin paths resolve correctly against the agent definition's directory.

title.zh-TW: MCP OAuth 支援逾千字超長授權碼，身分驗證不再受阻
title.en: MCP OAuth Now Supports Long Authorization Codes Exceeding 1024 Characters

body.zh-TW: 透過外部授權伺服器綁定帳號時，長序號不再卡死登入流程。使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）進行 OAuth 登入驗證時，如果授權伺服器回傳長度超過 1024 個字元的授權碼，過去系統會因長度限制而判定失敗；現在這項門檻限制已經修復，長度超過 1024 字元的授權碼也能順利通過驗證並完成服務連接。⟦如同大樓門禁閘門升級了感應容量，過去訪客通行證條碼超過特定字數就會讀取失敗，現在遇到長條碼也能順暢感應通關。⟧
body.en: When connecting accounts via external authorization servers, lengthy tokens no longer block your sign-in flow. During MCP (Model Context Protocol) OAuth authentication, if an authorization server returned an authorization code longer than 1024 characters, the process previously failed due to a length limitation. This limit has now been fixed, allowing authorization codes exceeding 1024 characters to authenticate successfully and complete the connection. ⟦It is like upgrading an office security gate so that long visitor badge barcodes, which previously triggered scan errors, now scan and grant access without a hitch.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth authentication failing when authorization servers return authorization codes longer than 1024 characters.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 技能面板路徑比對，全域與工作區技能正確歸類
title.en: Fixed Windows Skill Path Matching to Properly Classify Global and Workspace Skills

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上檢視已安裝的擴充技能時，面板清單中的分類與層級變得更加精準。過去在 Windows 環境開啟 `/skills` 面板時，由於主機路徑分隔符號（反斜線 `\`）的比對問題，導致全域技能與工作區技能經常被錯誤分類；現在路徑比對與分組邏輯已完成修正，所有技能都會依其實際路徑正確歸類到所屬群組。⟦猶如圖書館檔案室校正了索書號的辨識標籤，不再因為標籤上的斜線方向不同，就把總館的常備書籍誤標成分館專屬藏書。⟧
body.en: When viewing installed skills on Windows, categories and groupings in the panel are now much more accurate. Previously, when opening the `/skills` panel on Windows, host path separators (the backslash `\`) caused global and workspace skills to be misclassified due to path-matching issues. The path-matching and grouping logic has now been corrected so that all skills are properly sorted into their respective groups based on their actual paths. ⟦It is like a library archive fixing call number label recognition, ensuring books from the central library are no longer miscategorized as branch-exclusive items just because of the slash direction on the label.⟧

items.original: Fixed skill path matching and grouping in the `/skills` panel on Windows where host path separators (`\`) caused global and workspace skills to be misclassified.

title.zh-TW: 排除執行期重複授權與崩潰隱患，強化 `/boost` 與摘要處理穩定度
title.en: Fixed Duplicate Permissions and Runtime Crashes to Boost `/boost` and Summary Stability

body.zh-TW: 長時間執行多代理協作或重啟工作階段時，幾項影響執行階段與系統設定的底層問題已獲得修正。過去在重新載入工作階段與呼叫子代理時，設定檔會不斷累積重複的授權項目，現在已修正此累積現象。針對加速執行，改善了工作者工具配置以解決 `/boost` 在執行期失敗的問題。同時修復了背景摘要更新在軌跡關閉後因嘗試讀取快取步驟（暫存的歷史步驟）而引發的空指標嚴重崩潰。⟦這如同替工廠的自動化流水線做全面檢修，清除了多餘的重複通行許可並校準機具，還避免了抄表員在產線停機後誤查暫存紀錄而造成跳電。⟧
body.en: When running multi-agent workflows or reloading sessions over extended periods, several underlying runtime and configuration issues have now been resolved. Previously, reloading sessions or invoking subagents caused duplicate permission grants to accumulate in settings files, which has now been eliminated. For accelerated execution, worker tool configurations have been improved to prevent `/boost` from failing at runtime. Additionally, a fatal nil pointer crash caused by background summary updates attempting to read cached steps after trajectory closure has been fixed. ⟦It is like a complete overhaul of an automated factory line, clearing redundant access passes, calibrating machinery, and preventing inspectors from checking temporary records after line shutdowns to avoid power trips.⟧

items.original:
Fixed duplicate permission grants accumulating in configuration settings across session reloads and subagent invocations.
Fixed /boost failing at runtime by improving worker tool configurations.
Fixed a fatal nil pointer crash in the agent runtime caused by background summary updates attempting to read cached steps after trajectory closure.

title.zh-TW: 加固 Remote Control 反向通道路由，遠端連線傳輸更安全
title.en: Hardened Remote Control Reverse-Tunnel Routing for Safer Remote Connections

body.zh-TW: 從外部裝置遠端連線操控開發環境時，網路傳輸通道現在變得更加牢固。⟦這彷彿在總部與外勤特派員之間鋪設了加固的加密專用通道，並重新校準了路由方向，確保指令與數據往返時不會繞遠路或在中途受干擾。⟧Antigravity 提供的 Remote Control（讓使用者從遠端裝置操控本機對話的功能）依靠反向通道路由來轉發通訊；這次更新全面加固了反向通道路由的處理機制，大幅提升遠端連線時的連線穩定性與路由安全性。
body.en: When connecting from external devices to control your development environment, network transmission channels are now significantly more resilient. ⟦It is like laying a reinforced, encrypted dedicated conduit between headquarters and field operatives while recalibrating routing directions, ensuring instructions and data travel without detours or outside interference.⟧ Antigravity's Remote Control feature relies on reverse-tunnel routing to forward communication. This update hardens the reverse-tunnel routing mechanism, substantially improving connection stability and routing security during remote sessions.

items.original: Hardened Remote Control reverse-tunnel routing.

entries: Improved `/mcp` panel navigation so up and down arrow keys strictly navigate between MCP servers and plugins, left and right arrow keys cycle available actions, and `Esc` exits action mode or the panel.

title.zh-TW: `/mcp` 面板導覽更順手，方向鍵與退出鍵分工分明
title.en: Smoother `/mcp` Panel Navigation with Clear Arrow and Escape Key Roles

body.zh-TW: 你在 `/mcp` 面板裡挑選 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與外掛時，方向鍵的職責現在劃分得一清二楚。上下方向鍵專門在各個伺服器與外掛項目之間縱向移動，左右方向鍵負責循環切換該項目的可用動作，按下 `Esc` 鍵便能退出動作模式或關閉面板。⟦這有如操作電視選單，上下鍵負責挑頻道，左右鍵切換音軌或畫質選項，按返回鍵就乾脆退回上一層，不會按錯鍵就亂跳欄位。⟧
body.en: When navigating MCP (protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers and plugins in the `/mcp` panel, the roles of arrow keys are now clearly divided. Up and down arrow keys strictly move vertically between individual servers and plugins, left and right arrow keys cycle through available actions for the selected item, and pressing `Esc` exits action mode or closes the panel. ⟦It is like navigating a TV menu: up and down keys switch channels, left and right keys adjust audio tracks or video quality, and pressing back cleanly returns to the previous level without accidentally jumping across unrelated fields.⟧

items.original: Improved `/mcp` panel navigation so up and down arrow keys strictly navigate between MCP servers and plugins, left and right arrow keys cycle available actions, and `Esc` exits action mode or the panel.

title.zh-TW: `/agents` 選單自動去重，跨來源不再冒出重複代理
title.en: Automatic Deduplication in `/agents` Picker Eliminates Duplicate Agents Across Sources

body.zh-TW: ⟦當不同部門的通訊錄都登記了同一個聯絡人，聰明的手機只會合併顯示一次，而不是在選單列出一長串分身。⟧當你在多個設定來源或外掛中定義了同名代理（agent，替你執行特定任務的 AI 助手），打開 `/agents` 選單時不會再看見重複項目的干擾了。過去系統在探索時，只要從不同設定來源或外掛發現同名代理，就會把每一筆都重複列在挑選器中；現在選單已經會自動去重，確保清單乾淨清爽。
body.en: ⟦When contact books across different departments list the exact same person, a smart phone merges them into a single entry rather than cluttering your list with duplicate profiles.⟧ When you define agents (assistants that perform specific tasks) with identical names across multiple configuration sources or plugins, opening the `/agents` picker no longer shows distracting duplicates. Previously during discovery, finding an agent with the same name across different sources or plugins listed every instance in the picker; the menu now automatically deduplicates entries, keeping your selection list clean.

items.original: Fixed duplicate agent entries appearing in the `/agents` picker when an agent with the same name is discovered across multiple configuration sources or plugins.

title.zh-TW: 啟動目錄失效也不怕，工具與代理初始化照常運作
title.en: Tool and Agent Initialization Succeeds Even from Deleted Working Directories

body.zh-TW: ⟦出門在外即使腳下的暫停點突然消失，只要隨身手冊記的是完整全球座標，導航就能照常運作。⟧就算你在一處已被刪除或無法存取的工作目錄中啟動命令列，工具初始化與代理啟動程序也不會再莫名崩潰。以前系統在處理記憶體中的參數架構時，會因目錄失效而找不到相對參照；現在全面改用絕對 URI（統一資源識別碼，以標準格式標記位置的字串）格式，確保各項工具與代理在任何目錄狀態下都能順利初始化。
body.en: ⟦Even if your temporary waypoint disappears under your feet while traveling, navigation continues smoothly as long as your guidebook records full global coordinates.⟧ Launching the command line from a working directory that has been deleted or is inaccessible will no longer cause tool initialization or agent startup to crash. Previously, parameter schemas held in memory lost relative references when the directory was invalid; switching fully to absolute URI schemes ensures all tools and agents initialize reliably regardless of directory state.

items.original: Fixed tool initialization and agent startup failing when launched from an inaccessible or deleted working directory by using absolute URI schemes for in-memory parameter schemas.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式輸出不再卡死，子行程自動釋放管線
title.en: Headless CLI Invocations with Pipes Exit Cleanly Without Hanging

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像工人下班離開工地時主動鎖緊水閥，才不會讓水管一直通水而卡住後續的工程驗收。⟧撰寫自動化腳本時，你在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的背景執行模式）下透過管線接收標準輸出或標準錯誤，程式結束時不再無故卡死。過去背景派生出來的子行程會持續霸佔呼叫端的管線，導致主程式遲遲無法順利關閉退出；現在系統已在保留的串流上加上 `FD_CLOEXEC` 標記，在結束時徹底釋放所有管線資源。
body.en: ⟦It is like workers shutting off the main water valve before leaving a construction site, ensuring pipes do not stay pressurized and stall subsequent inspections.⟧ When running automation scripts in headless mode (background execution without a visual interface) with piped standard output or standard error, invocations no longer hang on exit. Previously, spawned child processes kept the caller's pipes open and prevented the main process from shutting down cleanly; setting `FD_CLOEXEC` on preserved streams now ensures all pipe resources are fully released on exit.

items.original: Fixed headless CLI invocations with piped standard output or standard error hanging on exit by setting `FD_CLOEXEC` on the preserved streams so child processes do not keep the caller's pipes open.

title.zh-TW: `mcp_config.json` 語法更寬容，註解與結尾逗號照單全收
title.en: Lenient `mcp_config.json` Parsing Supports Comments and Trailing Commas

body.zh-TW: 手動編輯工具設定檔時，你不必再為隨手寫下的筆記或多打的逗號膽戰心驚了。過去在 `mcp_config.json` 檔案中加入單行註解 `//`、多行註解 `/* */` 或是在結尾多留尾隨逗號，都會導致 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）設定解析失敗；現在解析器已具備更佳的容錯能力，能順利讀取帶有註解與多餘逗號的設定內容。⟦這宛如一位懂通融的表單審查員，看見備註欄旁的手寫附註或句末多點的逗號，能自然看懂填表內容，不再直接退件。⟧
body.en: When manually editing tool configurations, you no longer need to worry about quick notes or extra commas breaking your setup. Previously, adding single-line comments `//`, multi-line comments `/* */`, or trailing commas in `mcp_config.json` caused MCP (protocol connecting AI to external tools) configuration parsing to fail; the parser is now more forgiving and reads configurations containing comments and trailing commas smoothly. ⟦It is like an understanding form inspector who effortlessly processes notes in margins or accidental punctuation marks without rejecting the entire submission.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP configuration parsing failing when `mcp_config.json` contains single-line (`//`) comments, multi-line (`/* */`) comments, or trailing commas.

title.zh-TW: 刪除對話徹底清理，不再殘留孤立註記檔案
title.en: Deleting Conversations Thoroughly Cleans Up Orphaned Annotation Files

body.zh-TW: 清理舊對話時，本機硬碟空間現在會被收拾得乾乾淨淨。以前每當你刪除對話紀錄，系統雖然移除了主對話，卻常把關聯的註記檔案遺留在本機儲存空間中，隨著時間推移默默堆積成無用的孤立檔案；這次修正補齊了刪除邏輯，會在刪掉對話的同時自動清除對應的註記檔案。⟦就像撕掉牆上的舊海報時，順手把固定在四周的雙面膠殘膠刮除乾淨，不讓碎屑在牆角日積月累。⟧
body.en: When clearing old conversations, your local disk space is now kept completely tidy. Previously, deleting a conversation removed the main chat but often left associated annotation files in local storage, gradually accumulating useless orphaned files over time; the deletion logic has been updated to automatically prune matching annotations alongside the conversation. ⟦It is like removing an old poster from a wall and scraping off the leftover adhesive tape around the edges, preventing stray scraps from piling up in corners.⟧

items.original: Fixed orphaned annotation files accumulating in local storage when deleting conversations.

title.zh-TW: 目標執行中隨口提問，`/btw` 不再強行推進或亂叫工具
title.en: Side Questions via `/btw` No Longer Force Goal Progress or Trigger Unintended Tools

body.zh-TW: 在 AI 全力衝刺大專案的中途，你終於能安心插話問個小問題了。當你開啟 `/goal` 指令讓系統執行長期目標時，若中途打 `/btw`（順帶一提，用來向 AI 提出旁支問題的指令）插話發問，先前系統常會把這則閒聊誤當作目標的一部分強行繼續推動，甚至亂呼叫工具；現在兩者狀態已徹底拆開，插問只會解答當前疑問，絕不干擾進行中的主任務。⟦彷彿你在主廚埋頭做大菜時問一句鹽巴放哪，他轉頭答完就回歸料理，不會突然把鹽巴整罐倒進湯裡胡亂攪拌。⟧
body.en: While AI is actively working through a major project, you can now safely ask quick side questions without derailment. When running a long-term goal with `/goal`, asking a side question with `/btw` (by the way, a command for asking auxiliary questions) previously led to treating the tangent as part of the active goal, forcing unwanted progression and unintended tool calls; their execution states are now decoupled so side questions resolve your query without interrupting the main task. ⟦It is like asking a chef cooking an elaborate meal where the salt is: they answer and resume cooking immediately, rather than dumping the entire salt container into the soup.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/btw` side questions in conversations with an active `/goal` being forced to continue and making unintended tool calls.
